title: Declared components travel in 'consumer-session/create' as 'config.components', as written.
why: behavioural spec 'janus': when the options declare components, 'consumer-session/create' carries them as 'config.components', each declaration as written except that a 'file' source's 'reference' with no root is resolved against the working directory. No declaration is checked, fetched or opened by the SDK.
note: The reference begins at the root, so the case means the same in every language whatever its working directory — and on every operating system: on Windows it names no drive, which one language's path library calls absolute and another's does not, and it is passed as written all the same. Nothing exists at it: a scripted engine loads nothing, and an SDK that opened the file would fail here.
